source.binary: libUnreal.so loaded by the live TFT PBE process

methodology.mapping: offset-zero libUnreal.so mapping plus storage VMAs recovered from the same SHA-256 binary
methodology.read: four bytes per known FAutoConsoleVariableRef storage through root /proc/PID/mem
methodology.scope: post-initialization live storage; this establishes effective values but not FPS benefit

interpretation.ubo_pool: The configured 16777216-byte pool remains in live storage after OpenGL initialization and is not a startup-only or silently reverted setting.
interpretation.direct_write: This one-factor pool run keeps UBODirectWrite at zero, preserving isolation from the direct-write candidate.
interpretation.mapping_flags: All non-UBO values match the direct-write run, including already-enabled map/discard/unsynchronized paths.
interpretation.boundary: Promotion still requires matched late-PvP A/B and render-correctness checks.
